entities.summary: Austin Charles Hedges is an American professional baseball catcher for the Cleveland Guardians of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the San Diego Padres, Pittsburgh Pirates and Texas Rangers, with whom he won the World Series in 2023.
